pages.title: Eel Photophore
pages.text: A light organ from an Ice Eel, still glowing: luciferin and its enzyme, lighting a lure in water that has never seen the Sun. Dropped by Ice Eels in Titan's hidden ocean.
$(thing)Dropped by$(): Ice Eel.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bioluminescent Membrane, Hydrothermal Chimney, Stable Ecosystem.
